title: Share of global rare earth element demand met by e-waste recycling

source.name: Global E-waste Monitor 2024
source.publisher: United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR) / International Telecommunication Union (ITU)

notes: The Global E-waste Monitor 2024 found that recycled e-waste meets only about 1% of global rare earth element demand, with the remaining 99% coming from newly mined material, even though e-waste contains recoverable gold, copper, and rare earths.
